budget.costNote: Docs list 40 credits/s when duration_seconds is set; measured on 2026-10-06 (creator tier): 33 credits for a 3 s clip. The generator estimates with the conservative 40/s and tracks real spend via /v1/usage/character-stats.

lines.text: Good evening, contractors. The van departs at oh-four-hundred. Punctuality is a survival trait.
Attention. The van departs shortly. Contractors left on site will be invoiced for the inconvenience.
Facility power has been interrupted. Please remain calm. Please remain quiet. Please remain.
Reminder: the shift quota has not been met. The Company believes in you. Statistically, it should not.
Reminder: the Core is Company property and requires two carriers. Damage will be deducted from survivors.
The van is now departing. Thank you for your service. Your next of kin have been notified in advance.

proposed.note: env-audio v1.2 (STRETCH): prompts only, NOT generated. fetch-assets --generate reads "clips" only; a prompt moves into clips only with the user's explicit OK (costs credits). The procedural synth kinds (apps/client/src/audio/synth.ts) and theme beds (beds.ts) play until then.
